sentences.en: Irritable men are always the last to know about things.
sentences.zh: 易怒的人总是最后一个知道事情。

sentences.en: He is always a little irritable in the morning.
sentences.zh: 他早上总是有点儿急躁。

sentences.en: Are you still having trouble with your irritable brother?
sentences.zh: 你还在和那个容易激动的哥哥闹别扭吗？

senses.zh: 易怒的，急躁的,过敏的,应激性的,毛躁
